features: Subtitles are now embedded inside the video itself — VLC lists them as subtitle tracks and no extra files sit in the folder. English, Spanish, Russian, German and Hindi are embedded when the source offers them; English is always included for Sub downloads.
fixes: Downloads from streams with a separate audio track no longer come out silent — the audio is now fetched and mixed in with the video.
A downloaded file with no audio track now fails honestly with a clear message instead of completing silently.
The download percentage no longer freezes near the end and then jumps to Completed — it keeps moving through the final step.
